# Create a sketch for the base of the box on XY plane
sketch_base = doc.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "Sketch_Base")

# Add rectangle in XY plane at Z=0 using vertices
v1 = FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 0)
v2 = FreeCAD.Vector(52, 0, 0)
v3 = FreeCAD.Vector(52, 38, 0)
v4 = FreeCAD.Vector(0, 38, 0)

# Add edges as line segments
idx1 = sketch_base.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(v1, v2), False)
idx2 = sketch_base.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(v2, v3), False)
idx3 = sketch_base.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(v3, v4), False)
idx4 = sketch_base.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(v4, v1), False)

# Add coincident constraints to close the loop
sketch_base.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", idx1, 1, idx2, 0))
sketch_base.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", idx2, 1, idx3, 0))
sketch_base.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", idx3, 1, idx4, 0))
sketch_base.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", idx4, 1, idx1, 0))

# Pad the sketch to create the box (height = 12mm along Z)
pad = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Pad", "Pad")
pad.Profile = sketch_base
pad.Length = 12.0

# Add pad to body using addObjects

print("Box pad created and added to body")

# Recompute to ensure valid shapes

# Axis along Z, ring in XY plane

print(f"Box shape volume: {box_shape.Volume}")

# Move the torus to position (26, 19, 12)

print(f"Cut shape volume: {cut_shape.Volume}")

# For a proper Part Design workflow, we need to create a pocket feature
# The pocket needs a profile (sketch) and a depth specification

# Alternative: Create a Part::Feature with the final cut shape
# This won't be fully parametric but will represent the result

final_feature.Shape = cut_shape

# Also add this to the body

doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

print(f"All objects: {[obj.Name for obj in doc.Objects]}")
